risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantified disclosure on impairments, cost savings, segment drivers, and the 2019 outlook, but includes extensive boilerplate forward-looking language and frequent qualifications. Risk tone is moderately negative, reflecting structural declines in checks and forms, customer loss, pricing allowances, impairment charges, higher costs, and reliance on cost reductions and acquisitions to support earnings. Forecasts remain cautiously confident but exclude potentially material investments and future asset-sale gains.
